newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - India slides in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - India slides in thin trade.

text.p: CAPEL INDEX LEVEL CHANGE PERCENT PREMIUM (pct)
Indian Global Depositary Receipts closed lower in thin trade despite a slight rally in Bombay in low volumes.
"The attitude towards India from foreigners is not positive and there was no real lead from Bombay," said a trader.
The Bombay Stock Exchange 30 Share Index closed 21 points higher at 3,154.61.
Some investors had been hoping for tax exemptions from Indias finance minister, but his budget speech will not come until Monday.
"There is a certain level of fatigue in the market and worries over the mass of new issues," the trader added.
The Korea Composite Index rose 16.71 points to close at 782.87.
The Taiwan Weighted Index fell 2.61 points or 0.04 percent to close at 6,309.82.
